title: Autofix Definition IDs for All Definitions
description: When running autofix, it should automatically add missing IDs for ALL definitions (not just exported/public ones) in all languages (Go, TypeScript, Python, C#, Rust). Currently isExportedDefinition filters out unexported definitions so no breach is generated for them. Example: `func isLicenseText(text string) bool {` should get an ID comment added. Implement this for all languages and add test coverage for Go autofix.
summary: Changed isExportedDefinition to always return true so ALL definitions generate BreachCodeDefMissingIdentification. Added explicit Go case in autofix switch. Extended tests to cover unexported variants for all languages. Updated fixture files.
